name: juice-shop
note: Ground-truth reference for finding classes that DAST can detect without auth. Set A is scored (recall); set B is the inherent limit of unauthenticated DAST (a miss is normal, not a failure). 'Optional' items need a specific engine in the roster, or are partly validated true negatives.

detectable.name: Weak or missing security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame, X-Recruiting)
Exposed SPA source (main.js / source map)
detectable.note: the juice-shop source map is often a true negative (SPA fallback text/html)

detectable.name: Cookie without Secure/HttpOnly
detectable.note: partly validated as true negatives on juice-shop

detectable.name: Outdated JS dependencies (vulnerable libs)
detectable.note: needs the retire.js engine in the roster (not on by default)

detectable.name: Injection/stack trace on malformed input (e.g. error-based SQLi)
detectable.note: needs the nuclei-dast engine; medium confidence

blind_spots: SQLi login bypass (' OR 1=1--) on an interactive form
Broken access control (admin panel, another user's basket), JWT forgery/weak JWT
Sensitive data through authenticated APIs, 2FA/OAuth, most gamified challenges
